transcript_summary: Customer asked about credit card limit increase. Agent verified identity, explained eligibility criteria, submitted request. Customer thanked agent.

Customer reported unauthorized transaction. Agent took 8 minutes to locate the transaction, asked customer to repeat details twice, did not offer interim resolution timeline. Customer expressed frustration twice during the call.

Customer requested statement reissue. Agent handled politely, slight delay verifying email on file, resolved successfully.
